## About

Zuxriddin Hasanov (also known as: HasanovTech, Hasanov, Zuxriddin) is a Frontend Developer and Mentor from Uzbekistan. He specializes in React.js and Next.js and builds modern web applications. He is a Mentor at Open Web Academy, and Founder of TypeX.uz and Eko-gps.uz.
